description_en: Retrieves the version information of the feature that is used to create an instance
description_zh: 获取当前功能新建实例时使用的版本信息
kebab_example: aliyun opensearch get-function-current-version --function-name ctr --model-type tf_checkpoint --function-type PAAS --domain ecommerce --category general --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetFunctionCurrentVersion

parameters.description_en:
The name of the feature. Valid values:

- ctr: Click-through rate (CTR) model

- pop: Popularity model

- category: Category model

- hot: Hotword model

- hint: Hint model

- suggest: Drop-down suggestion model

- analyzer: Word segmentation model

- termweight: Term weighting model
parameters.description_zh:
功能名称，支持的模型有：

- CTR模型：ctr
- 人气模型：pop
- 类目模型：category
- 热词模型：hot
- 底纹模型：hint
- 下拉提示模型：suggest
- 分词模型：analyzer
- 词权重模型：termweight
